title: There is no suction...which is why I bought this
text: There is no suction...which is why I bought this. Our bathtub was re-glazed at our apartment and the maintenance crew specifically mentioned to get a mat without suction cups beneath it. I was really hesitant about this mat since I had never bought one this expensive but boy was it worth it. Not only does it cover nearly the entire bottom of the bathtub, it doesn't slide around and still isn't suctioned down. It's great and we've been able to maintain the finish no problem. The only downside is hair, but it seems to get stuck on the outside of it so it's easy to remove/ keep clean.

product_metadata.title: Leotruny Bath Tub Shower Mat 40 x 16 Inch Non-Slip Soft PVC Loofah Mats for Bathroom (C04-Mix Color)
features: No Suction Cups: Made of durable, Phthalate-free, PVC plastic. It uses an anti-slip layer that stays firm while being gentle on tub surfaces. Instead of traditional bath mats with difficult cleaning suction cups, which may slide around and damage your tub or floor surface.

Comfort Shower: The loofah texture of the top surface gently massages and exfoliates your feet while providing a cushioned and comfortable support when you are in the shower, away from the hard and cold ordinary bathroom mat.

Special Drain Holes: As natural drain holes, loop surface and lattice bottom can work together to encourage water to flow past the bath mat without getting caught. Our mats have a cut-out for the bathtub drain area. No need to worry about blocking water.

Easy to Clean: You can simply use a shower head to rinse out the foam on the mat top. Hanging the mat over the tub or shower door after each use. The mat can dry fast and will not get moldy easily, which creates no smell and marks on your floor.

More Safe: The anti-slip layer on its bottom can ensure the safety of your family by holding the mat steadily in place. Elderly people and children welcome. Safe and ideal for any use in your private home and public places, like restaurants, hospitals, nursing homes, schools, childcare facilities, etc. (Note: Not suitable for bathtubs filled with water, the mat will float)
